lines.t: Buongiorno, my helper! Look what came today.
The gold goes around the mirror, not on top of it. The glass stays clear.
Maybe! A border goes all the way around.
Hmm. The mirror is big. We'll have to check.
The same? That would be a surprise. Let's see.
Good. "Not sure yet" is a fine place to start.
The border is 2 inches wide on every side.
Let's find out how many gold sheets the border needs.
You took the painting away. Good. That is the right idea.
Your math is right, my friend. But look at the frame.
I think I see it. Do you?
Because you found the whole size first, then took the mirror away.
A fence does not cover the garden. It goes around the edge. That is a new puzzle for next time.
This is the Duke's new mirror.
It is 8 inches long and 6 inches wide.
Our gold sheets. Each one is a square, 1 inch on every side.

lines.t: Master Leonardo! The Duke wrote again. Here is his letter.
Master Leonardo, this painting needs a gold frame, 2 inches wide on every side. I found how many sheets!
And 11 times 9 is 99. I checked it twice!
Master Leonardo! The border is done. Every gold sheet fit.
The Duke has a new wish. He sent another letter.
